title: Climate protesters win groundbreaking class action against Victoria police over use of capsicum spray
summary: Potentially precedent-setting case brought after Jordan Brown hit with capsicum spray outside mining and resources conference in Melbourne in 2019 Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Climate protesters have won a class action against Victoria police over their use of capsicum spray during an anti-mining demonstration in Melbourne. The first class action against Victoria police in relation to alleged excessive use of oleoresin capsicum (OC) spray was heard in the state’s supreme court earlier this year, and a decision was handed down on Friday.
